title: WCLC 2026 SCLC Phase 3 Results: Two B7-H3 ADCs and MAVERICK
summary: At WCLC 2026, two Phase 3 B7-H3 ADCs each reduced the risk of death by 54% versus topotecan in relapsed SCLC; MAVERICK improved cognitive outcomes.
body_markdown:
At WCLC 2026, two Phase 3 B7-H3 antibody-drug conjugates, tambotatug pelitecan and risvutatug rezetecan, each reduced the risk of death by 54% versus topotecan in relapsed SCLC[\[1\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-taishan-302-trial-shows-tam-peli-significantly-improves-survival)[\[2\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-artemis-008-trial-shows-risvutatug-rezetecan-significantly) . MAVERICK showed better cognitive failure-free survival with MRI surveillance alone than with MRI plus prophylactic cranial irradiation, while its final overall-survival analysis remained pending[\[3\]](https://www.swog.org/news-events/news/2026/09/18/brain-mri-surveillance-without-pci-improves-sclc-cognitive-outcomes) .


Updated: October 12, 2026.


## MAVERICK separates cognitive outcomes from survival follow-up


MAVERICK evaluated a surveillance strategy after initial therapy, with 304 patients who had limited-stage or extensive-stage SCLC and no brain metastases on MRI[\[3\]](https://www.swog.org/news-events/news/2026/09/18/brain-mri-surveillance-without-pci-improves-sclc-cognitive-outcomes) . Randomization compared MRI alone with MRI plus prophylactic cranial irradiation.


After 22 months of median follow-up among living patients, MRI alone improved cognitive failure-free survival, with a hazard ratio of 0.60 and a 90% confidence interval of 0.46 to 0.78[\[3\]](https://www.swog.org/news-events/news/2026/09/18/brain-mri-surveillance-without-pci-improves-sclc-cognitive-outcomes) . The preliminary overall-survival analysis, after 128 deaths, reported a hazard ratio of 0.90; final analysis was planned after 190 deaths.


## TAISHAN-302 adds randomized survival evidence for Tam-Peli


TAISHAN-302 evaluated tambotatug pelitecan, or Tam-Peli, against topotecan after first-line platinum-based treatment, enrolling 451 patients across 85 sites in China[\[4\]](https://www.medilinkthera.com/news-details/62) .


The two relapse trials reported the following results at their interim analyses[\[1\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-taishan-302-trial-shows-tam-peli-significantly-improves-survival)[\[2\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-artemis-008-trial-shows-risvutatug-rezetecan-significantly) .


Trial Patients Median OS, ADC / topotecan OS hazard ratio Median PFS, ADC / topotecan Response rate, ADC / topotecan


TAISHAN-302 451 13.3 / 9.4 months 0.46 7.4 / 2.8 months 59.1% / 9.7%


ARTEMIS-008 461 18.5 / 10.3 months 0.46 7.2 / 3.0 months 58.3% / 12.6%


Each trial compared its ADC with topotecan separately; results are not a head-to-head comparison[\[1\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-taishan-302-trial-shows-tam-peli-significantly-improves-survival)[\[2\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-artemis-008-trial-shows-risvutatug-rezetecan-significantly) .


TAISHAN-302 also reported grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events in 46.4% of Tam-Peli recipients and 74.7% of topotecan recipients[\[1\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-taishan-302-trial-shows-tam-peli-significantly-improves-survival) . Treatment-emergent interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis occurred in 4.9% and 1.4%, respectively.


## ARTEMIS-008 provides a second B7-H3 survival readout


ARTEMIS-008 tested risvutatug rezetecan, or Ris-Rez, in 461 patients in China whose SCLC had progressed after platinum-based chemotherapy[\[2\]](https://www.iaslc.org/iaslc-news/press-release/phase-iii-artemis-008-trial-shows-risvutatug-rezetecan-significantly) . At the June 6 data cutoff, median follow-up was 12.2 months.


GSK reported grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events in 60.9% of Ris-Rez recipients and 78.2% of topotecan recipients[\[5\]](https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/ris-rez-reduced-risk-of-death-by-54-versus-topotecan-in-patients-with-relapsed-small-cell-lung-cancer-in-china/) . The most common severe treatment-related events were hematologic, including decreases in neutrophils, white blood cells and platelets, as well as anemia.


## September filings connect the readouts to regional execution


MediLink reported that China's regulator accepted its Tam-Peli application on September 2, with priority review subsequently granted[\[4\]](https://www.medilinkthera.com/news-details/62) . The company also described Roche's rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize Tam-Peli worldwide outside mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau.


Hansoh's September 13 disclosure similarly reported acceptance of the Ris-Rez application in China on September 2 and priority review[\[6\]](https://www.hspharm.com/news/news-detail-513503.htm) . GSK described development outside mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, including the Phase 3 EMBOLD SCLC-301 study, with pivotal data expected in 2027[\[5\]](https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/ris-rez-reduced-risk-of-death-by-54-versus-topotecan-in-patients-with-relapsed-small-cell-lung-cancer-in-china/) .


## Final Perspective


Taken together, the three presentations establish two lines of analysis: cognitive outcomes after initial therapy, and randomized drug outcomes after relapse. The two B7-H3 programs give the relapse field separate Phase 3 survival datasets, while MAVERICK brings treatment burden and continued survival follow-up into the assessment.
